svg.title: Terrace Tideway — Kelp terraces fed by stepped freshwater spillways
svg.desc: Tidal gardens step down toward lower pools. An upper boardwalk stays dry, while bypass valve decks, harvested kelp baskets and exposed shell ledges create a low-tide loop.
svg.text: Kelp terraces fed by stepped freshwater spillways
Tidal gardens step down toward lower pools. An upper boardwalk stays dry, while bypass valve decks, harvested
kelp baskets and exposed shell ledges create a low-tide loop.
